source.title: Absolute continuity, Lyapunov exponents and rigidity I : geodesic flows

accepted.question_text: Does dynamic coherence persist under perturbations of partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms? More explicitly, let f be a partially hyperbolic diffeomorphism of a compact Riemannian manifold with invariant tangent splitting into unstable, center, and stable bundles, written as E^u, E^c, and E^s. Say that f is dynamically coherent when there are f-invariant center-stable and center-unstable foliations tangent to E^c + E^s and E^c + E^u, respectively, and their intersections give an invariant center foliation W^c. If f is dynamically coherent, is every perturbation of f also dynamically coherent?

evidence.quote: It is not known whether every perturbation of a dynamically coherent diffeomorphism is dynamically coherent

accepted.question_text: For a fixed differentiability class C^r with r >= 1, is accessibility C^r-dense among partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms whose center bundle has dimension greater than one? Here a partially hyperbolic diffeomorphism is accessible when any two points in the ambient manifold can be joined by an su-path, meaning a piecewise smooth path whose every leg lies in a single stable leaf W^s or a single unstable leaf W^u. The question asks for the higher-center-dimensional case of the Pugh-Shub accessibility-density conjecture, after the one-dimensional center case has been settled in the cited results.

evidence.quote: It remains open whether C r -density still holds when dim Ec > 1.
